auto.text: Autonomous paths adapt to missing notes and advance to later notes. Latency-compensated odometry at 200 Hz runs in a background thread for accurate paths.

cycle.text: The under-bumper intake centers a note and a beam break lights LEDs. The launcher rotates in line with the intake, takes the handoff and keeps the note ready for amp, speaker or trap. Undefended speaker shots are automated, with targeting that does not need a stop.

endgame.text: Raise the hooks to the chain, pull the robot up, raise the launcher until its intake side meets the trap, and roll the note in. The sequence is automated; the operator only presses continue.

fallback.text: A preset shooting location backs up vision. When defended, the launcher rises to full height and shoots at one set angle.

changed.text: The team tried top and bottom, left and right, and wind-up shooters; top and bottom worked best with compression and spin. The roller was once filled with wheels, and some came out for weight with little or no loss of accuracy.

outcome.text: 35-11-1 in official play; ranked 3 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 59.54, Johnson).

solves.text: Funnel a note to the center so it can leave in only one position

facts.text: Solid rollers between the swerve modules do not move out
Omni wheels, an HDPE surface and 3D printed wedges funnel notes sideways
The intake will not run when a note is already held

functions.name: Launcher

solves.text: Serve the speaker, amp and trap from one carriage

cost.text: The wheels are heavy, so those that barely touch the note were removed

functions.type: top and bottom wheel shooter on a fully rotating carriage

facts.text: Handoff rollers stage the note and feed the launching wheels, and run in reverse for the trap
Launching wheels sit on non-parallel axles to add a stabilizing spin
The carriage can rotate all the way around

The interview says that for the amp it rises and flips, and intake wheels, not shooter wheels, roll the note out for more control; the handout says the handoff rollers feed the launching wheels for the amp
Wheels are spaced for the ratio of contact to weight

solves.text: Reach the trap, and shoot over defense

facts.text: Elevator and climber are driven by hex shafts that run under the belly pan

functions.name: Climber

solves.text: Climb and still leave the launcher free to score in the trap

functions.type: linear rail climber with two hooks

facts.text: Compact and centered, independent of the launcher elevator
A cutout in the polycarbonate hooks is the width of the chain, so the robot does not move after climbing
Climb and elevator moves are split to avoid the chain

solves.text: Aim the launcher and automate handoff and scoring

facts.text: The handout says a Limelight sets the launcher angle and 200 Hz odometry runs for autonomous; the interview says two Limelights and, when asked about odometry, only the AprilTag
Two beam breaks detect the note and automate the handoff
Motion-aware targeting scores in the speaker without stopping

decisions.because: they let the note move sideways while wedges funnel it to the center
decisions.instead_of: mecanum and rubber wheels, both tried

decisions.because: they gave the best mix of compression and spin
decisions.instead_of: left and right and wind-up shooters

decisions.choice: Remove shooter wheels that barely touch the note
decisions.because: wheels are heavy, and accuracy did not drop much if at all

decisions.choice: Climber separate from the launcher elevator
Raise the launcher to shoot when defended
decisions.because: it lets the robot score at a set angle, as a counter to teams that block it

decisions.choice: Score the amp with the intake wheels
decisions.because: they give more control and roll the note in
